news.title: Allu Arjun and Atlee's High-Budget Project Raaka Eyes Two-Part Release
news.summary: Icon Star Allu Arjun is currently collaborating with director Atlee on the grand, international-standard project Raaka, produced by Sun Pictures. news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Crunch as Streaming Platforms Cut Budgets
news.summary: Digital streaming platforms are tightening budgets and offering lower prices for post-theatrical rights, impacting Tollywood producers. With deals now increasingly linked to box office success, large-budget and medium-range films are facing financial hurdles. This shift is pushing filmmakers to rely more heavily on theatrical revenue and focus on controlled production costs.
